title: Polynomial-space decidability of quantified Boolean formulas
statement: The language of bit strings that decode to true quantified Boolean formulas is decidable by a finite Turing machine using at most $c(n^c+1)$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$, for some natural number $c$.
